raw.description:
As a Business Analyst you will be aligning the program's strategic vision and business outcomes with the delivered results. You will lead group workshops to identify strategic drivers and develop use cases, requirements, and policies. Besides, you will provide analytical expertise to identify cost-effective eCommerce solutions that meet business objectives and user needs.

This role requires excellent communication skills, a consultative mindset, and fluency in both Spanish and English, as you’ll be working with Spanish-speaking stakeholders as well as international delivery teams.

Your Responsibilities

  • Focus on ensuring that strategic vision and desired business outcomes of the program are in constant alignment to what is being delivered
  • Lead group workshops to identify strategic drivers and develop required use cases, functional requirements, and technical requirements
  • Documenting future state business processes and assisting in the development of policies and procedures
  • Facilitating the alignment of stakeholders to develop future state vision/value definitions
  • Provide expertise in the functional use of Shopify (Plus, B2B suite) and optionally BigCommerce, including app ecosystem, headless/composable setups, multi-store architecture and custom storefront flows.
  • Ensure quality and relevance of user requirements, functional specifications, technical specifications, data models, and process flow diagrams to control engagement scope, maintain high delivery quality and ultimately deliver project successfully
  • Provide expertise on the functional use of Commerce platforms and tools
  • Collaborate with project manager to ensure business objectives are aligned with the project plan
  • Provide consultation to client stakeholders on modern Shopify-native commerce architectures: product catalog modeling within Shopify metafields and headless structures, inventory sync, subscription & bundled products, multi-market configurations, B2B user roles, app integrations (ERP, PIM, OMS), conversion optimization, as well as optional BigCommerce-specific capabilities.
  • Act as a bridge between the client, technical and creative teams; facilitating internal, technical and client design reviews; and ensuring that delivered application remains true to the creative design
  • Leverage Shopify Analytics, GA4 and third-party data tools to identify growth opportunities (AOV, upsell funnel efficiency, checkout conversion across markets). If applicable, interpret BigCommerce analytics as a secondary data source.

Requirements

  • 5+ years experience in a client-facing Business Analyst or Business Consultant role, preferably in a Professional Services or IT Consulting environment
  • Professional fluency in Spanish and English (written and spoken)
  • Experience with Shopify (Plus / B2B) or similar commerce platforms. BigCommerce knowledge or certification is considered a strong plus.
  • Highly-developed problem solving, planning and organizational skills
  • Experience with full life-cycle projects from initial scoping through delivery
  • Proficient in processes including defining and documenting test strategy as well as unit and integration testing
  • Excellent presentation, communication and interpersonal skills, with ability to engage and manage senior-level client relationships
  • Comfort with agile, iterative software development methodologies
  • Interest in digital commerce technology and eager to learn about new technologies, best practices, and 3rd party tools
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as needed on a cross-functional, geographically dispersed

Benefits

  • Unlimited Vacation/PTO
  • Fully remote and distributed teams
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Ongoing training and education opportunities
  • 0% Bureaucracy Culture - Focus is on responsibilities, not title

raw.excerpt: REE Medical is seeking a Senior Instructional Designer to build training content, SOPs, and operational documentation from the ground up.
raw.description:
REE Medical is seeking a Senior Instructional Designer to build training content, SOPs, and operational documentation from the ground up. This role is embedded directly within operations and will work hands-on with subject matter experts to extract undocumented processes, design curriculum, and produce structured training materials across multiple teams. You will be responsible for creating e-learning content, facilitator guides, assessments, and process documentation in an environment where most institutional knowledge currently lives as tribal knowledge, scattered recordings, or informal notes. This is a builder role. You are designing and producing the training materials that will define how this organization onboards, upskills, and scales.

Key Responsibilities

Content Development & Instructional Design

  • Build training content, SOPs, and workflow documentation from scratch for multiple operational teams with distinct processes and skill requirements
  • Design structured learning paths that sequence content logically for new hire onboarding, cross-training, and ongoing skill development
  • Create clear, engaging instructional content that breaks down complex multi-step workflows into consumable, retention-focused training
  • Develop reusable templates and content standards that enable future content creators across the organization to build consistently

Process Documentation & SME Collaboration

  • Conduct structured interviews and working sessions with subject matter experts and team managers to extract, validate, and document workflows
  • Observe and map operational processes that currently exist only as tribal knowledge, turning "how we actually do things" into documented, trainable content
  • Partner with leadership and team managers to identify training gaps, prioritize content builds, and validate accuracy of documented processes
  • Translate complex operational procedures into structured documentation that serves both as training material and as living reference

Training Program Management

  • Own the content architecture, determining how training is organized, categorized, and sequenced across teams and roles
  • Establish content governance standards including version control, review cycles, update triggers, and ownership assignments
  • Build and manage a content maintenance cadence, ensuring SOPs and training stay current as processes change
  • Provide regular progress updates to leadership on build status, content coverage, and identified gaps

Continuous Improvement

  • Support process enhancement initiatives by updating training and documentation as workflows are refined
  • Identify opportunities where clearer documentation or better training design can improve operational performance
  • Build feedback loops with teams to identify where training is falling short and iterate accordingly

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Instructional Design, Organizational Development, Communications, or equivalent relevant experience
  • 5+ years of experience in instructional design, curriculum development, or L&D content creation, with at least 2 years focused on operational or process-based training
  • Demonstrated portfolio of training programs, SOPs, or curriculum built from scratch in environments where documentation did not previously exist
  • Experience supporting complex, multi-department operations with 50+ employees across distinct teams, each with unique workflows and training needs
  • Proven experience leading SME extraction sessions, including structuring interviews, validating process accuracy, and converting verbal knowledge into published, structured training content
  • Experience architecting training platforms end-to-end, including information hierarchy, role-based learning paths, content categorization, and user navigation
  • Strong written communication with the ability to translate highly technical, multi-step operational processes into clear, accessible training for varied skill levels
  • Experience establishing and maintaining content update cycles tied to process changes, ensuring training never falls out of alignment with live operations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Trainual or similar SOP-focused training platforms (Lessonly, Guru, Confluence, Notion)
  • Experience building training infrastructure for organizations during periods of rapid growth or operational scaling (2x+ headcount growth)
  • Background in operations-heavy environments with multi-step, compliance-sensitive workflows requiring high accuracy
  • Experience integrating multimedia content (Loom recordings, screen captures, embedded video) into structured training modules
  • Experience working in remote-first or distributed team environments across multiple time zones
  • Comfort working across multiple operational systems (project management, CRM, communication platforms) and documenting how they interconnect within workflows
  • Experience creating train-the-trainer programs or enabling managers to become content contributors within an established framework

Benefits

What REE Offers you:

At REE, we believe in empowering our employees to thrive both personally and professionally. When you join our team, you become part of a dynamic and inclusive work environment where innovation and collaboration are celebrated.

Comprehensive Benefits Package

  • Competitive salary: $70,000 - $90,000/yr depending on experience.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance with Company-sponsored Life Insurance
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Vacation time off, sick time off, and holidays

Career Development Opportunities

  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Opportunities for advancement within the company

Work-Life Balance

  • Flexible work schedules
  • Remote-first environment with company-wide conferences annually
  • Employee assistance program for personal and family well-being

Perks and Rewards

  • Employee discounts on products and services through Insperity
  • Recognition programs for outstanding performance
  • Company-sponsored social events and activities
  • Ability to travel twice per year, to Annual Company Conference and IT Team Onsite, as well as potential for additional Leadership meetings.

Join us and discover a rewarding career where you can make a difference and grow professionally.


REE is only able to hire US citizens or those who are authorized to work in the US as full-time employees (we do not provide visa sponsorship).

This information is provided in compliance with Equal Pay Regulations across the US and is the company’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation range and benefits offered for this position. The compensation offered to the successful applicant may vary based on factors including experience, skills, education, location, and other job-related reasons.

About the Role

The Strategy, Platforms & Transformation team is dedicated to enabling improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. We collaborate within the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data-driven decision-making. Reporting into ED, AI Strategy and Innovation, this role is crucial in driving AI transformation by bringing the best in AI and tech to unlock opportunities for growth and improve patient outcomes.

The Associate Director, AI Engineer will lead the engineering strategy, design, development, deployment, and ongoing optimization of our agentic AI platform and solutions. This role is responsible for building scalable, secure, and reliable AI-driven systems that transform existing products, processes, and workflows into intelligent, agentic AI experiences. As a key technical leader, the Associate Director will partner closely with product, data, architecture, security, and business teams to define platform capabilities, drive implementation excellence, and operationalize continuous improvement across the AI lifecycle. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in AI engineering, platform architecture, and production operations, along with a strong track record of translating emerging AI capabilities into practical, high-impact business solutions.

Major Accountabilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and engineering delivery of the organization's agentic AI platform and related solutions.
  • Drive the transformation of existing products, processes, and workflows into scalable agentic AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Oversee end-to-end AI engineering operations, including development, deployment, monitoring, reliability, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define technical roadmaps, platform standards, and solution priorities aligned to business goals.
  • Establish engineering best practices for AI system performance, scalability, security, governance, and maintainability.
  • Guide the evaluation, integration, and optimization of AI models, orchestration frameworks, and supporting platform components.
  • Build, mentor, and lead high-performing engineering teams while fostering innovation, accountability, and technical excellence.
  • Identify opportunities to accelerate value delivery through reusable AI services, automation, and operational efficiencies.

Essential Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required and advanced degree preferred, ideally in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related technical field.
  • Six plus years of experience in technology leadership, solution architecture, software engineering, or prototype development, with a strong track record of building and advancing proofs of concept for digital, data driven, or AI enabled solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience translating early-stage concepts into functional prototypes or PoCs, including evaluating technical feasibility, defining solution approaches, and working through ambiguty to validate ideas quickly and effectively.
  • Strong technical knowledge across modern application development, cloud platforms, data, and AI technologies, with the ability to partner closely with Product, Innovation, Engineering, and Data Science teams to bring concepts to life.
  • Experience leading cross functional technical efforts, including guiding developers, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring PoC work aligns with business goals, user needs, and longer term technical direction.
  • Strong problem solving, communication, and execution skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in fast paced innovation environments.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors. Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards. US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. Position Overview

As a senior developer on the Member Administration team, you will be creating solutions to ensure seamless member management for Autodesk Forma customers. The Member Administration team plays a crucial role in providing a seamless experience for our customers when it comes to managing their memberships, permissions, and subscriptions. Our mission is to provide the base layer for powerful Forma member management tools to enable customers to access what they need when they need it. We ensure that our customers can easily manage subscriptions, products, and accounts.

Autodesk Forma is a large-scale construction management application used by the leading construction and engineering firms in the world to organize and deliver on large scale projects. Forma connects teams and project data from design to done—reducing risk, protecting profits, and increasing predictability. In Forma, we have 5 separate cloud ecosystems, over 400 developers across 9 time zones, innovating 29 individual products. To scale and deliver value to our customers effectively we need powerful tools and administration services to make the enterprise experience exciting.

Location: This role is remote in Canada.

Job Title: AI Digital Product Sr Manager - AI Studio (REMOTE)

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

AI Digital Product Sr Manager - AI Studio

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead a cross-functional product team that rapidly discovers, builds, launches, and scales AI-powered solutions that accelerate scientific discovery, streamline R&D workflows, and improve enterprise decision making.

Working across engineering, AI engineering, data science, UX, and business teams, you will translate emerging AI capabilities into production-ready enterprise applications. You will balance rapid experimentation with enterprise quality, delivering AI products in 2 to 6 month development cycles while driving measurable business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead AI Product Strategy and Delivery: Own the strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and delivery of a portfolio of AI applications and intelligent agents. Lead a cross-functional product team through discovery, delivery, and continuous improvement.

Evaluate and prioritize AI opportunities based on customer value, technical feasibility, business impact, and strategic alignment.

  • Drive Customer Discovery: Partner with scientists, researchers, business stakeholders, and end users to understand workflows, identify high-value AI opportunities, validate solutions, and continuously improve products through user research and rapid prototyping.
  • Bridge Business and Technology: Translate business needs into product requirements and partner with engineering, AI engineering, data science, UX, and external partners to deliver impactful AI solutions.
  • Deliver and Scale AI Products: Lead AI products from opportunity discovery through enterprise deployment using rapid experimentation, iterative delivery, and customer feedback. Build reusable product patterns that accelerate future AI delivery while ensuring products are scalable, reliable, secure, and cost effective.
  • Measure Success: Own product KPIs including adoption, usage, customer satisfaction, model quality, reliability, latency, and business impact, using analytics, experimentation, and customer feedback to continuously improve products.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a AI Digital Product Sr Manager with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience leading digital AI products, defining product strategy and roadmaps, and measuring product success.
  • Strong technical fluency across AI technologies, cloud platforms, APIs, and modern software development.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with software engineers, AI engineers, data scientists, UX designers, architects, and business stakeholders.
  • Excellent critical thinking, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Master's degree and 6 years of Information/Technology Systems experience OR
  • Bachelor's degree and 8 years of Information/Technology Systems experience OR
  • Diploma and 12 years of Information/Technology Systems experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years delivering AI/ML, enterprise software, or digital products.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams delivering AI applications, intelligent agents, or enterprise software from concept through enterprise adoption.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, RAG, prompt engineering, AI evaluation, and ML productization in enterprise environments.
  • Experience with enterprise AI platforms and modern cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, OpenAI, MLflow, or comparable AI development platforms.
  • Experience applying customer discovery, rapid prototyping, experimentation, analytics, and AI quality metrics to guide product decisions.
  • Experience partnering with engineering, AI engineering, security, and business teams while communicating product strategy and outcomes to executive leadership.
  • Familiarity with biotechnology, pharmaceutical research, laboratory, clinical, or scientific workflows is preferred.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental & vision coverage, and life & disability insurance
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

careers.amgen.com

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Sponsorship

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.

About the company

Our client operates a leading global marketplace that connects high-growth startups and scale-ups with rigorously vetted software engineering talent. By specializing in the rapid placement of senior-level developers, the team helps innovative companies worldwide accelerate their product roadmaps, launch MVPs, and stabilize technical infrastructure. Their platform supports a vast array of technologies, including AI, blockchain, and full-stack web development, ensuring that businesses can scale their engineering capacity with month-to-month flexibility and precision-matched expertise.

Driven by a commitment to quality over automation, the company employs a human-centric vetting process to identify the top 1% of technical talent across Europe, LatAm, and the US. They foster a remote-first, high-performance culture that values technical excellence and impactful storytelling through code. As a fast-growing player in the HR-tech and talent acquisition space, they offer an environment where efficiency and innovation intersect, helping partners bridge the global skill gap while providing developers with opportunities to work on cutting-edge international projects.

Job Type: Full-time

Job Summary

We are seeking a high-velocity, "scrappy," and deeply experienced Communications Manager to own our global narrative. This is not a typical corporate PR role—there are no agencies to manage and no "fluff" to hide behind. You will be responsible for building direct relationships with Tier-1 tech journalists, ghostwriting for our executive team, and scaling our Share of Voice across North America and Europe. This is a role for a hands-on executor who thrives in a lean startup environment and knows exactly how to get a story picked up by TechCrunch or Forbes through sheer grit and creative pitching.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organic Media Relations: Execute high-impact, direct pitching to Tier-1 and tech-specific media outlets to secure organic placements.
  • Executive Thought Leadership: Act as a ghostwriter and narrative architect for founders, developing high-signal content for LinkedIn, newsletters, and industry publications.
  • Content Distribution: Build and manage AI-assisted workflows to repurpose core insights into LinkedIn carousels, threads, and high-velocity distribution assets.
  • Brand Monitoring: Actively track brand mentions and industry trends to identify "newsjacking" opportunities and keep the team at the center of the global tech conversation.
  • Strategic Growth: Expand the company’s Share of Voice (SoV) in the US and EU markets, moving beyond traditional PR into modern GTM channels like podcasts and interactive newsletters.

Requirements

  • Proven Media Track Record: A documented history of securing organic placements in Tier-1 global tech media (e.g., TechCrunch, Forbes, Wired, VentureBeat).
  • Exceptional Narrative Skills: Advanced (C1/C2) English proficiency with the ability to capture a founder’s voice and transform complex tech topics into compelling stories.
  • Scrappy Execution: 100% autonomy and the ability to deliver massive results without the support of external agencies or large advertising budgets.
  • Technical Proficiency: Professional experience with media databases (Muck Rack, Prowly), LinkedIn automation, and advanced AI-assisted content tools.
  • Startup Mindset: A proactive, direct, and outcome-oriented personality that thrives in a fast-paced, high-velocity environment.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience launching or scaling high-growth B2B SaaS or tech marketplaces in the US market.
  • A background in modern GTM strategies, including executive personal branding and podcast guesting.
  • Experience transitioning traditional PR functions into data-driven, automated content machines.

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary

🌎 Fully remote work environment

🚀 Career growth opportunities to own and scale the global communications function

⏰ Flexible working hours with a focus on results over desk time

🛠️ High autonomy with minimal corporate bureaucracy

📈 Long-term stability in a fast-growing, established tech company

raw.description:
About Command|Link

Command|Link is a global SaaS Platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions,helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform. Command|Link has revolutionized the IT industry by tackling the problems our competitors create. In recognition for our unprecedented innovation and dedication, Command|Link was recognized as the SD-WAN Product of the Year, ITSM Visionary Spotlight, UCaaS Product of the Year, NaaS Product of the Year, Supplier of the Year, and the AT&T Strategic Growth Partner. Command|Link has built the only IT platform for scale that solves ISP vendor sprawl and IT headaches. We make it easy for our customers to get more done, maximize uptime and improve the bottom line.

Learn more about us here!

This is a 100% remote opportunity.

About your new role:

The Managed Services Network Engineer is a critical role responsible for supporting and delivering superior service to ISP/MSP business customers. You will play a key part in managing and troubleshooting SDWAN networks (with an emphasis on Versa Networks), business data circuits, VoIP services, VPNs, Managed Routers, Firewalls, and other custom-managed services.

No travel to customer locations is required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide end-to-end support for customers with a focus on SDWAN (preferably Versa Networks), Internet, and related services.
  • Troubleshoot and configure basic LAN setups (Routers, Firewalls) and Microsoft operating systems.
  • Support the provisioning and onboarding of new customers for managed services.
  • Collaborate with vendors to resolve support issues and ensure smooth service delivery.
  • Own support issues from start to resolution, ensuring customer satisfaction with clear communication and expert problem-solving.
  • Maintain excellent customer relationships by delivering outstanding support and going the extra mile.
  • Mentor and train fellow engineers on complex technical issues and solutions.

What you'll need for success:

  • High School Diploma or GED Equivalent
  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in a fast-paced technical environment, with demonstrated expertise in SDWAN, particularly Versa Networks.
  • CCNA and CCNP certification is highly desirable
  • Command line experience with networking tools (e.g., Cisco, Fortinet, Juniper).
  • Strong firewall configuration experience (e.g., Fortinet).
  • Deep understanding and hands-on experience with BGP, OSPF, and VRRP.
  • Practical knowledge of basic routers, firewalls, and NAT (Network Address Translation).
  • Experience with COS/QOS and network design principles.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 compliance and processes.

Why you'll love life at Command|Link

Join us at CommandLink, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of business communication. We value the innovative spirit and seek individuals ready to bring their unique vision and expertise to a team that values bold ideas and strategic thinking. Are you ready to make an impact?

  • Room to grow at a high-growth company
  • An environment that celebrates ideas and innovation
  • Your work will have a tangible impact
  • Flexible time off
  • Fun events at cool locations
  • Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team

At CommandLink, we’re committed to creating a fair, consistent, and efficient hiring experience. As part of our process, we use AI-assisted tools to help review and analyze applications. These tools support our recruiting team by identifying qualifications and experience that align with the requirements of each role.

AI tools are used only to assist in the evaluation process — they do not make final hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting or hiring team before any decisions are made.

raw.description:
Are you excited by the opportunity to mentor journalists, shape editorial strategy, and drive excellence across award-winning data-driven reporting?

Do you enjoy uncovering meaningful stories in complex datasets and turning them into journalism that informs and engages readers?

About our Team

Law360® provides breaking legal news and analysis on the most important topics legal professionals, business leaders and regulators need to stay on top of issues, safeguard clients and sharpen their competitive edge. The award-winning journalism of Law360 keeps readers connected to the latest, most essential news and insights across 70+ practice areas, industries and jurisdictions, including federal litigation, business deals, mergers & acquisitions, security and more. Law360, which serves more than 2.7 million readers every day, is owned by LexisNexis Legal & Professional® and part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers.

About the Role

Law360 is seeking an Assistant Managing Editor to lead the editorial side of our data team – overseeing reporters, editors and research specialists who turn data into compelling, rigorous journalism and making sure our data-driven series are reported, written, edited and produced to the highest standards.

This is a hands-on editorial leadership role. The AME will shape story ideas, coach reporters and editors, and own the quality of everything the team publishes, from recurring data series to one-off investigative pieces. The AME will work closely with graphics, research and survey analysts to make sure the numbers behind our stories are sound and the storytelling around them is clear and engaging.

The AME will also help develop new data-driven series, identify datasets worth building, and help guide and shape surveys and research that are topical and genuinely relevant to our audience. We're looking for someone who can look at a dataset and see the stories that readers will care about.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of data reporters and editors, setting clear standards for reporting, writing and production across our data-driven series.

  • Ensure data journalism is edited for accuracy, clarity, fairness and narrative strength – making sure complex numbers translate into stories readers can actually use.

  • Develop and pitch story and series ideas, and guide projects from concept through publication in collaboration with reporters, editors and graphics staff.

  • Coach and develop reporters and editors, helping them sharpen both their data skills and their writing.

  • Own the editorial quality and integrity of the team's output, including how data and statistical findings are interpreted and presented.

  • Partner with survey and research specialists to make sure reporting is accurate, well-sourced and clearly explained.

  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration so stories publish on time and meet the highest standards.

Requirements

  • 7-10+ years of relevant experience in newsrooms, with a strong track record in data-driven or investigative reporting and editing

  • Demonstrated leadership or team management experience in a newsroom

  • Sharp editorial judgment and strong editing skills, especially with data-heavy stories

  • Comfort working with data of varying quality and completeness, and the ability to spot when the numbers don't add up

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams

Preferences

  • Experience editing or producing recurring data series or investigative projects

  • Familiarity with data analysis tools such as R or Python

  • Experience with data visualization techniques

  • Legal industry reporting or research experience

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

  • Degree in journalism, public policy, political science, economics, statistics or a related field

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, and study assistance, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

About the Business

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

Pay Plan Title:Member Services Representative I – Bilingual

Working Title:Member Services Representative I – Bilingual

FLSA Status:Non-Exempt

Posting Salary Range:$36,192 - $45,964

Office Location:Remote within North Carolina

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Member Services Representative I – Bilingual to join our team! The Member Services Representative I – Bilingual is responsible for providing non-clinical administrative support to the Member Services Department. The Member Services Representative I – Bilingual primary responsibility is to answer inbound calls and assist callers by connecting them to the appropriate party, sharing information, providing technical assistance, answering questions, handling and/or resolving complaints. The Member and Recipient Services Department is often the first interaction with our agency therefore the call agent must respond to the caller’s needs in a professional service-oriented manner and maintain the highest level of customer satisfaction by seeking first call resolution. The Member Services Representative I – Bilingual is directly supervised by the Member and Recipient Services Supervisor. Employee may be asked to work outside of the normal schedule (8:30am-5pm) to accommodate the needs of the Member and Recipient Services Department.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Work in a call center environment, interact with callers to deliver information, answer frequently asked questions and address complaints. This position handles mostly inbound calls from members & recipients, family members, providers, Trillium stakeholders, community partners and various government agencies. The Member Services Representative I may provide members & recipients with information regarding providers within our network so that the consumer can make an informed choice of service provider. This employee does not make any clinical determinations or interpretations of any clinical information. The Member Services Representative I do not take the lead on emergency calls; they must contact a licensed clinical staff member to a take the lead on the call.
  • Gather and/or update data, such as but not limited to, demographic information, referral source, payer source, current provider, provider choice and appointments.
  • Collect, monitor and organize data needed for various databases, reports or reviews.
  • Review call notes, enrollments, registrations or other identified documents for completeness and/or accuracy.
  • Perform general clerical work for the Member and Recipient Services Department, or other identified staff or departments approved by leadership.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • High school diploma or GED and one (1) year of call center, member services, or customer service experience; OR
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Fluent or conversational Spanish speaking ability.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within North Carolina.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • One (1) year of work experience in mental health, substance abuse, and developmental disabilities.

Deadline for Application:August 27, 2026 at 11:59pm

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.

Nos ajude a desenhar a solução!

  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentor em engenharia de software e IA para múltiplos times e projetos;
  • Apoiar decisões arquiteturais visando qualidade, escalabilidade, sustentabilidade e integração inteligente de capacidades de IA/LLMs nas soluções;
  • Disseminar o uso de engenharia guiada por especificações (Spec-Driven Development - SDD) e automações inteligentes no fluxo de trabalho dos times de produto;
  • Atuar de forma pareada com a gestão dos projetos, apoiando planejamento, avaliação de riscos técnicos, estimativas e trade-offs;
  • Participar de entrevistas técnicas e no apoio à formação e estruturação de times;
  • Conduzir treinamentos técnicos internos e para parceiros (cobrindo desde arquitetura até engenharia de IA);
  • Apoiar a disseminação de boas práticas de engenharia, arquitetura, testes e qualidade interna/externa;
  • Contribuir ativamente no desenvolvimento técnico e profissional de pessoas (mentoria, feedbacks e apoio a PDIs).

Requisitos para se candidatar a vaga:

  • Atuação ativa na definição e evolução de arquiteturas modernas, com foco em manutenibilidade, escalabilidade e qualidade;
  • Perfil totalmente hands-on, atuando na prática em código, arquitetura e prototipação de soluções;
  • Conhecimento prático em Spec-Driven Development (SDD) ou abordagens similares baseadas em especificações executáveis para orientar arquitetura, design e geração de código;
  • Domínio dos fundamentos e práticas de Engenharia de IA (AI Engineering): integração de LLMs/modelos em aplicações, abordagens de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), uso de Bancos Vetoriais e orquestração de Agentes de IA no fluxo de trabalho;
  • Capacidade de compreender tecnologias, linguagens e frameworks como meios, mantendo abertura para aprender além da sua stack principal;
  • Experiência com Modelagem Orientada ao Domínio (DDD);
  • Boas práticas de design de código: TDD, Clean Code, modelagem rica, KISS, YAGNI, DRY, SOLID e Design Patterns;
  • Modelagem de arquitetura: Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, Onion, fundamentos de sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos;
  • Mentalidade Lean e de Arquitetura Mínima Viável (MVA);
  • Pirâmide de testes e automação de testes em múltiplas camadas (garantindo qualidade interna e externa);
  • Vivência em cultura DevOps / MLOps, com integração contínua (CI/CD) e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC);
  • Conhecimento de métricas de engenharia e eficiência de entrega (Complexidade Ciclomática e Cognitiva, DORA Metrics como Lead Time e Deploy Frequency, além de métricas de uso e custos de IA).

Será legal se você tiver conhecimento em:

  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico para tomada de decisão;
  • Pensamento orientado a produto, conectando soluções técnicas ao valor de negócio;
  • Experiência em cloud pública (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e serviços nativos de IA (ex: Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI);
  • Ecossistemas e frameworks de orquestração de IA e agentes (ex: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI);
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Experiência como instrutor(a) de treinamentos ou palestrante técnico;

Remote role

Push the boundaries of tech. In your sweatpants.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior macOS Swift Software Developer to help us change the way the world works, with Parallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity. Here, you’ll develop cutting edge graphics virtualization technology with our Parallels team.

The top creative and technical minds could work anywhere.So why are so many of them choosing Corel? Here are three reasons:

  1. This is the moment.It’s an exciting time at Corel, with new leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.

Cool with us. We believe that happy employees mean happy customers. That’s why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let’s talk more about this role and see if we’re destined to be together.

  • Build high-quality native GUI experiences for Parallels Desktop products using Swift

  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex issues affecting product quality and user experience

You

Nice to Have

US:

Mindrift is looking for skilled Frontend Developers (HTML/CSS/JavaScript, React/Next.js) to join the Tendem project () and build high-quality landing pages and multi-page websites for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your frontend development expertise and design sensibility to build pixel-perfect, responsive, and conversion-focused websites that meet real client requirements. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in landing page production, multi-page website development, and modern frontend frameworks.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Frontend Developer, you'll design, build, and refine landing pages, waitlist pages, promo pages, and small multi-page sites (portfolios, restaurant sites, small business sites, simple online stores), turning client briefs into responsive, performant, polished web experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build landing pages, waitlist pages, and promo pages with clear hero sections, CTAs, and conversion-focused layouts.
  • Build small multi-page websites (Home, About, Services, Contact, etc.) that follow client requirements and basic information architecture.
  • Implement responsive, mobile-first layouts that work cleanly across devices and browsers.
  • Integrate forms, email capture, basic analytics, and simple CMS or headless content sources.
  • Apply on-page SEO basics (semantic HTML, meta tags, performance, accessibility) so pages are ready to rank and run ads against.
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refine frontend markup, styling, structure, and content placement to deliver production-quality websites.
  • Troubleshoot layout, performance, and cross-browser issues independently.

Requirements

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in frontend development, landing page production, or website development (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Design, or related fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in modern frontend development, responsive web design, and building high-quality landing pages and small websites. We are looking for specialists who can create polished, conversion-focused user experiences, work confidently with modern frontend frameworks, and build production-ready user interfaces. A strong visual eye, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including responsive design, Flexbox, and Grid.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Next.js, Vue, Astro, or similar).
  • Experience with utility-first CSS (Tailwind) or modern component libraries.
  • Ability to translate Figma designs or written briefs into clean, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with form handling, email capture services, and basic analytics setup (GA4, Plausible, or similar).
  • Working knowledge of on-page SEO, accessibility (WCAG basics), and Core Web Vitals.
  • Comfortable working with simple CMSs or headless content (Webflow, Framer, Sanity, Contentful, or similar) is a plus.

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and visual taste — pages should look intentional, not generic.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to deliver complete pages with minimal supervision.
  • Portfolio of shipped landing pages and/or small websites (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

The Medical Records Specialist is responsible for requesting, managing, organizing, and ensuring appropriate follow up for accurate and timely patient medical records and bills while ensuring compliance with HIPAA, third parties, and all applicable federal and state privacy regulations. This role supports client care operations by processing medical record requests, maintaining system accuracy and client profile updates, verifying documentation accuracy and timeliness, and coordinating with healthcare providers, insurance companies, and internal teams. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

What You Will Own

  • Process, retrieve, review, and load pertinent and appropriately shared medical record and bill information for clients in electronic and physical formats.
  • Receive and fulfill medical record requests from patients, attorneys, insurance companies, healthcare providers, and authorized third parties.
  • Ensure all records are complete, accurate, and compliant with HIPAA and organizational policies.
  • Upload, index, and organize medical documentation within the company's case management system.
  • Verify patient information and obtain appropriate authorizations prior to releasing records.
  • Monitor outstanding medical record requests and proactively follow up with healthcare providers to minimize delays.
  • Identify missing documentation and coordinate with providers to obtain complete records.
  • Maintain detailed tracking of requests, receipts, and processing timelines.
  • Collaborate with legal, case management, and operations teams to ensure records are available to support active cases.
  • Review medical records for completeness and escalate discrepancies or concerns when necessary.
  • Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive medical information.
  • Assist with audits and quality assurance initiatives to ensure data integrity.
  • Support process improvement initiatives that increase efficiency and reduce turnaround times.

What You Bring

Required:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of experience in medical records/medical bills, health information management, healthcare administration, or a related field or in personal injury or workmans comp managing medical records or bills.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA regulations and medical records privacy requirements.
  • Experience with digital systems and ease of navigation with multiple platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple requests while meeting deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Associate's degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
  • Experience supporting personal injury, legal, or insurance organizations.
  • Familiarity with case management software such as Filevine, Litify, or similar platforms.
  • RHIT, RHIA, or other Health Information Management certification is a plus.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

Pivot Energy is in an exciting growth period and is looking to expand its C&I pipeline by developing an interconnection and incentive process that is scalable for the diverse markets in which we operate. This is a position with tremendous growth potential that involves working across multiple teams. The individual hired for this role must be organized, collaborative, and goal-oriented.

    • Takes ownership of assigned tasks and offers support to colleagues to meet team goals
    • Builds and maintains collaborative relationships across the team and organization

    • ability to break down complex problems into manageable components, understands the relationships between different elements, and identifies patterns or trends
    • resourcefulness in seeking out information, tools, or support that can help address challenges effectively, and develops or documents information necessary to reduce future issues
    • Offers constructive feedback that encourages alignment with organizational values
    • Database of Interconnection and Incentive Requirements

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES

  • Passion to learn new things through self-study and structured settings
  • Demonstrated abilities to coordinate across internal and external teams

PREFERRED COMPETENCIES

  • Industry Experience: Minimum of 2 years' experience in electrical infrastructure engineering, with a focus on utility coordination and load interconnection.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of electrical investor-owned utilities and grid interconnection processes.
  • Utility Coordination Skills: Proven experience navigating utility processes to secure interconnection points.
  • Knowledge of interconnection application, net metering, and incentive processes. Experience interacting with variety of utilities across the country

We appreciate your interest in partnering with us; however, we are not seeking recruitment agency support for this role.

ABOUT PIVOT

Pivot Energy is a national renewable energy provider that develops, finances, builds, owns, and manages solar and energy storage projects that help decarbonize our nation’s electricity, increase equitable access to clean energy for local communities, and provide real cost-savings to American businesses and
families.
We are fiercely dedicated to accelerating the rapid transition taking place in the energy industry to a more decentralized and cleaner approach to power generation. We are committed to positively contributing to the local communities and people we serve with more than clean energy. Immunome is a clinical-stage targeted oncology company committed to developing first-in-class and best-in-class targeted cancer therapies. We are advancing an innovative portfolio of therapeutics, supported by a leadership team with deep experience in the design, development, and commercialization of cutting-edge therapies, including antibody-drug conjugates. Our pipeline includes varegacestat, an investigational gamma secretase inhibitor for which an NDA has been accepted by the U.S. FDA; IM-1021, a clinical-stage ROR1 ADC; IM-1617, a clinical-stage solid tumor ADC; and IM-3050, a clinical-stage FAP-targeted radioligand therapy. We are also advancing a broad portfolio of early-stage ADCs pursuing undisclosed solid tumor targets.

Position Overview

The Senior Director, Clinical Field Monitoring and Trial Operations (FMTO) provides strategic and operational leadership for Immunome’s clinical trial monitoring function, accountable for implementing Immunome’s contract field monitoring team and standardizing monitoring strategy, oversight activities, KPIs, and dashboards across all trials and monitoring vendors to ensure site-level data quality, patient safety, and protocol compliance across Immunome’s oncology portfolio.

The Senior Director will lead and develop a high-performing field monitoring function, including a contract field monitoring team, partnering closely with Clinical Site and Trial Operations, Clinical Project Delivery Data Management, Clinical Development Systems, and Quality to ensure monitoring and TMF data, technology, and reporting enable enterprise-wide visibility into trial, site, and document performance.

The Senior Director may also take on management and development of other trial operations staff or teams to support expansion of Immunome’s trial operations capabilities as well as leading various trial oversight activities and operational initiatives.

Responsibilities

Monitoring Strategy & Trial Oversight

  • Own and evolve Immunome’s clinical monitoring strategy, including risk-based monitoring (RBM) and fit-for-purpose monitoring models (on-site, remote, and centralized), and standardize monitoring plans, KPIs, oversight activities, and dashboards across all trials and monitoring vendors in alignment with study risk profile, phase, and complexity, including review of protocols and study document for monitoring and trial operations feasibility.
  • Establish monitoring standards, templates, and best practices, including monitoring plan and report templates, and monitoring oversight programs.
  • Design and implement Immunome’s contract field monitoring team, including staffing model, sourcing, onboarding, and oversight framework.
  • Lead monitoring oversight across Immunome's clinical portfolio from site qualification through close-out, ensuring monitoring visits, source data verification, reporting and issue resolution meet timelines, quality standards, and regulatory expectations.
  • Identify and escalate site-level risks, protocol deviations, and data quality issues; drive rood cause analysis and corrective and preventative actions (CAPAs).

Clinical Operations Leadership

  • Build, lead, and mentor high-performing teams.
  • Conduct or oversee monitoring training and oversight visits to ensure consistent monitor performance and data quality across studies.
  • Partner with Project Delivery, Clinical Site and Trial Operations, and Clinical Development Systems to support study and vendor oversight, ensure inspection readiness across trials through QC reviews, KPI monitoring, and ongoing issue identification, trend analysis, and resolution.
  • Support long-term resource planning and department growth.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Vendor and CRO Management

  • Lead selection, management and oversight of contract field monitoring staffing partners and vendors with delegated monitoring responsibilities, ensuring consistent quality, performance, and KPIs across all contract monitors and CRO-provided monitors.
  • Ensure vendor compliance with contractual obligations, timelines, monitoring quality standards, and performance metrics.
  • Contribute to governance, vendor oversight, and quality management and improvement processes for effective monitoring activities.

Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure monitoring and TMF activities adhere to ICH-GCP, FDA, EMA, and global regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Quality Assurance on inspection readiness, audit response, and corrective actions related to monitoring, TMF, and site-level findings.
  • Drive operational excellence to ensure data integrity and consistent trial conduct.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Project Delivery, Clinical Site and Trial Operations, Clinical Development, Clinical Data Management, and Clinical Development Systems to align monitoring and TMF strategy, data flow, and technology (CTMS, eTMF, and risk-based monitoring/analytics platforms).
  • Represent Field Monitoring and TMF Oversight in governance meetings and provide operational input into strategic decisions.

Budget and Resource Management

  • Maintain financial oversight of monitoring budgets, and monitor contract scope and activities, whether conducted by in-house teams or outsourced.
  • Support Project Delivery in developing and forecasting monitoring budgets.
  • Oversee resource allocation across contract field monitoring and CTA teams to optimize costs, team performance, and deliver milestones on time.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with 14+ years of clinical monitoring experience within the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry, or equivalent combination of degree and years of experience.
  • Experience resourcing, building, and managing Clinical Monitoring Teams and related infrastructure – SOPs, template reports, plans, as well as contributing to the design and implementation of Clinical Trail Management Systems.
  • Experience defining, performing, and overseeing TMF QC activities.
  • Able to travel up to 30% for in-house meetings and various monitoring activities.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Deep understanding of clinical development processes, trial design, and global regulatory frameworks with expertise in clinical monitoring methodologies (on-site, remote, centralized, and risk-based).
  • Expertise in ICH-GCP, FDA, and EMA regulations, including source data verification, informed consent, and investigational product accountability.
  • Strong operational acumen and project management skills with experience implementing quality management and fit-for purpose monitoring models and systems.
  • Experience designing and standing up contract or FSP staffing models, including sourcing, onboarding, and performance management of contract CRAs.
  • Knowledge of TMF structure, content, and quality control, including the TMF Reference Model, essential document requirements, and TMF health metrics and KPIs
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence stakeholders at all organizational levels, and communicate, negotiate, and build relationships effectively.
  • Ability to build, lead, and mentor high-performing teams, including recruiting, training, and retaining staff.
  • Analytical mindset with a strategic approach to problem-solving and decision-making, including using monitoring data and analytics (KPIs, dashboards) to prioritize activities and resources.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects in a dynamic environment with a high degree of professionalism, adaptability, and accountability.

$260,965—$309,341 USD

🚀 Why Headout?

We’re a rocketship: 9-figure revenue, record growth, and profitable

With $200M+ in revenue, guests in 700+ cities, and 18 months of profitability, Headout is the fastest-growing marketplace in the travel industry, and we’re just getting started. We've raised $60M+ from top-tier investors and are building a durable company for the long term — because that's what our mission needs and deserves. We’re growing, profitable and nowhere near done.

What we do is important

In an increasingly digital world, there is a desperate need to augment our human experience by getting us to interact with the real world around us and the people in it. At Headout, our mission is to be the easiest, fastest, and most delightful way to head out to a real-life experience — from immersive tours to museums to live events and everything in between.

Why now?

The foundation is strong. The opportunity ahead is even bigger. We’ve hit profitability, built momentum, and proven the model — but there’s so much more to build. If you’re looking to join a company where the trajectory is steep and your impact is real, this is the moment.

Our culture

Reinventing the travel industry isn't easy, but that's the fun part.
We care deeply about ownership, craft, and impact, and we’re here to do the best work of our careers. We won’t pretend like it’s for everyone but if you’re a builder who loves solving tough problems, you’ll feel right at home.

👩‍💻 The role

At Headout, the Associate, Customer Experience isn't just a position - it's a commitment to excellence. Join our agile customer operations team, a group adept at swiftly addressing concerns and consistently delivering top-notch experiences. Your primary task? Ensuring every interaction with Headout leaves our customers satisfied and impressed. Please note that this role is for calls, emails and chat process.

This is a remote-first role, open to candidates across India.

🤩 What makes this role special?

  • Service-Oriented: Your passion lies in assisting others, ensuring our guests always leave with a smile, even if they initially reached out with an issue.
  • Multitasker: You can efficiently juggle queries, whether they come through chats, calls, or social media platforms.
  • Effective Communicator: Working cohesively with various internal teams, you ensure every guest query is addressed promptly and accurately.
  • Continuous Improvement: You're always on the lookout to enhance our internal processes, aiming for increased efficiency.

💝 What skills & experience do you need?

  • You’re Detail-Oriented: You have an eagle eye, catching even the tiniest of details that others might miss.
  • Language Skills: Fluent in English, both in writing and speech.
  • You’re Organized: Like Monica Geller from 'Friends', you're systematic, organized, and always seeking to optimize.
  • You’re Forward-thinking: You focus on lasting solutions rather than quick fixes.
  • You’re Agile.: Comfortable with shift work, understanding the need for flexibility in a 24/7 customer service environment.

🥰 Bonus

  • A passion for travel.
  • Previous experience assisting a global clientele

EEO statement

At Headout, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our partners, and the community at large. Headout provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability. During the interview process, if you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact the recruiter assigned to your application or email us at .

Privacy policy

Please note that once you apply for this job profile your personal data will be retained for a period of one (1) year. Headout shall process this data for recruitment purposes only. Once the relevant job profile is filled or once the time period of one (1) year from the date of the job application has passed, whichever is later, Headout shall either delete your data or inform you that it shall keep it in its database for future roles. In compliance with the relevant privacy laws, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that the processing of your personal data be restricted. If you have any concerns or questions about the way Headout handle your data, you can contact our Data Protection Officer for more information.

Sobre a Clicksign

Somos uma empresa brasileira líder em assinaturas eletrônicas. Em essência, facilitamos relações entre pessoas e empresas no ambiente digital. Por trás da nossa tecnologia de ponta e foco em segurança, temos a missão de fazer o mundo crescer, tornando as relações digitais cada vez mais inteligentes.

Como trabalhamos:

Nossa essência é o Trust. Trabalhamos com foco, ritmo, comunicação clara e dados para nos apoiar. Trabalhamos com capricho; colocamos cuidado e qualidade em tudo que fazemos. Empatia e respeito são pilares da nossa equipe.

Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Value Stream Leader para liderar nossa Value Stream de Jornada do Administrador.Você será responsável por construir soluções que tornem a administração da plataforma mais simples, segura e escalável, permitindo que as organizações gerenciem seus ambientes com autonomia e confiança.   • Conectar a estratégia da Value Stream aos objetivos de negócio e à geração de valor para clientes.

Liderança de produto e times:

  • Liderar e desenvolver times multidisciplinares compostos por Product Managers, Product Designers, Engenheiros e demais disciplinas.
  • Criar contexto estratégico e distribuir desafios de forma clara, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e foco em resultados.
  • Atuar como mentor(a) e coach das lideranças e especialistas da Value Stream, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das pessoas e a construção de times de alta performance.

Priorização e tomada de decisão:

  • Conduzir decisões complexas sobre evolução da jornada, direcionando investimentos e prioridades com base em impacto, estratégia e resultados.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre estratégia, execução e geração de valor.

Dados, descoberta e evolução de produto

  • Promover uma cultura de descoberta contínua, utilizando dados, pesquisas com clientes, tendências de mercado e novas tecnologias para embasar decisões.
  • Aprimorar continuamente os processos de estratégia e gestão de produto, elevando a maturidade e a capacidade de inovação da Clicksign.

Jornada do Administrador

  • Liderar a evolução das capacidades de administração da plataforma, com foco em autonomia, simplicidade e eficiência para os administradores, incluindo:
  • Gestão de usuários e permissões;
  • Autenticação corporativa (SSO e futuras capacidades de identidade);
  • Administração de múltiplas contas;
  • Gestão de grupos e estruturas organizacionais;
  • Configurações da plataforma;
  • Auditoria e rastreabilidade;
  • Relatórios administrativos;
  • Onboarding e setup organizacional;
  • Recursos que ampliem a autonomia dos administradores.

Segurança, governança e confiança:

  • Garantir que as soluções atendam aos padrões de segurança, controle, rastreabilidade e conformidade necessários para processos críticos dos clientes.

Comunicação e influência

  • Atuar como principal porta-voz da estratégia da Value Stream, conectando times, lideranças e stakeholders em torno de objetivos comuns e de uma visão compartilhada.
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes multidisciplinares de Produto e Tecnologia (Product Management, Product Design, Engenharia e áreas parceiras).
  • Profundo conhecimento em desenvolvimento de produtos digitais e metodologias ágeis.

  • Habilidade excepcional de comunicação e influência, com capacidade de inspirar e engajar diferentes públicos.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e orientação a dados para tomada de decisões.
  • Experiência em definir e implementar estratégias de produto de alto impacto.
  • Experiência na construção de produtos SaaS B2B voltados para administração, governança ou plataformas corporativas.
  • Paixão por resolver problemas complexos e entregar valor aos usuários.
  • Excelentes habilidades de coaching e desenvolvimento de pessoas.
  • Proatividade, autonomia e capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com produtos voltados para administração de plataformas, gestão de usuários, permissões, autenticação, SSO, RBAC ou governança de acessos.
  • Conhecimento sobre gestão de múltiplas contas, estruturas organizacionais e administração de ambientes corporativos.

  • Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias, plataformas, IA e Open Platforms.
  • Experiência em trabalhar com parceiros e construir ecossistemas de integração.

Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

﻿

  • Cultura de confiança, focada em resultados e com muito desafio e aprendizado.
  • Autonomia e protagonismo, em um ambiente cheio de colaboração e empatia.
  • Cultura de feedback e 1:1 com uma liderança humana e sem microgerenciamento.
  • Benefícios completos como: vale refeição/alimentação, auxílios creche, home office, saúde, educação e cultura, gympass, day-off de aniversário, descontos em terapia e cursos de inglês, entre outras parcerias.
