raw.description:
Fully Remote · Vollzeit oder Teilzeit · Ouchie

Wir sind Ouchie und entwickeln moderne Erste-Hilfe-Produkte für Kinder und Familien.

Unser nächstes Ziel: Ouchie soll in hunderten und perspektivisch tausenden Geschäften erhältlich sein, von Spielwarenläden über Kinderboutiquen und Concept Stores bis hin zu größeren Handelsketten.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der unseren B2B-Vertrieb aufbaut und operativ vorantreibt.

Dabei nutzen wir KI und moderne Tools, um passende Händler zu finden, zu qualifizieren, individuell anzusprechen und unseren Vertrieb systematisch zu skalieren.

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team mit tollen Produkten und freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Aufgaben

Du baust gemeinsam mit unserem Gründer den B2B-Vertrieb von Ouchie auf und entwickelst daraus einen skalierbaren Sales-Prozess.

Dazu gehören insbesondere:

  • Du identifizierst passende Händler in Deutschland, Österreich und perspektivisch weiteren Märkten.
  • Du findest mit Hilfe von KI, Datenbanken und eigenen Recherchen relevante Stores und Ansprechpartner.
  • Du qualifizierst Leads: Passt Ouchie wirklich zum Sortiment und zur Zielgruppe des Händlers?
  • Du sprichst Händler aktiv an, per E-Mail, Insta, LinkedIn, Telefon oder anderen sinnvollen Kanälen.
  • Du führst Verkaufsgespräche und gewinnst neue Handelspartner.
  • Du versendest Samples und Sales-Unterlagen und fasst konsequent nach.
  • Du betreust Händler vom Erstkontakt bis zur ersten Bestellung.
  • Du arbeitest daran, dass aus Erstbestellungen langfristige Händler mit regelmäßigen Nachbestellungen werden.
  • Du baust unser CRM und unsere Sales-Pipeline strukturiert auf.
  • Du testest verschiedene Zielgruppen, Pitches und Akquisewege und misst, was tatsächlich funktioniert.
  • Du unterstützt uns bei der Ansprache größerer Händler, Einkaufsverbände und Key Accounts.
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Ouchie schneller in den stationären Handel bringen können.

Unser Ziel ist nicht, möglichst viele E-Mails zu verschicken.

Unser Ziel ist: möglichst viele aktive Verkaufsstellen aufzubauen, bei denen sich Ouchie dauerhaft verkauft.

Qualifikation

Wichtiger als dein Lebenslauf ist für uns, dass du motiviert bist, verkaufen kannst, strukturiert arbeitest und Dinge selbstständig vorantreibst.

Ideal wäre:

  • (Erste) Erfahrung in B2B Sales / Business Development
  • Freude an aktiver Akquise und Telefonaten
  • sehr gute Kommunikation und ein gutes Gespür für Menschen
  • hohe Eigeninitiative und Ergebnisorientierung
  • strukturierte Arbeitsweise und sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen
  • Interesse an KI und modernen Sales-Tools
  • keine Scheu davor, neue Tools und Prozesse selbst auszuprobieren
  • sehr gutes Deutsch

Besonders spannend wäre Erfahrung oder ein bestehendes Netzwerk in Bereichen wie:

  • Spielwarenhandel
  • Baby- und Kinderfachhandel
  • Kindermode
  • Concept Stores
  • Geschenkartikel
  • Apotheken
  • Drogerie oder familiennahe Retail-Konzepte

Kontakte in die Branche sind ein großes Plus, aber ausdrücklich kein Muss.

Wenn du bisher in einer anderen Consumer-Goods-Branche gearbeitet hast und weißt, wie man Händler gewinnt, kann das genauso gut passen.

Benefits

  • Sehr gutes, erfolgsabhängiges Gehalt
  • Fully Remote
  • flexible Arbeitszeiten in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit möglich
  • sehr viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • direkter Zusammenarbeit mit den erfahrenen Gründern (u.a. ArtNight / Reailtainment Group)
  • die Möglichkeit, einen B2B-Vertrieb von Grund auf aufzubauen
  • moderne KI- und Sales-Tools statt unnötiger manueller Prozesse
  • viel Raum für eigene Ideen und Experimente

Ouchie ist noch am Anfang seiner Entwicklung, macht aber bereits im ersten Jahr sehr starke Umsätze.

Wenn du Lust hast, eine junge Consumer Brand dabei zu unterstützen, vom Onlineprodukt zu einer Marke zu werden, die deutschlandweit im Handel steht, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Was uns wichtig ist

Wir suchen keine Person, die auf Leads wartet.

Du solltest Spaß daran haben, selbst herauszufinden:

Welche Händler sollten Ouchie verkaufen und wie bekommen wir sie dazu?

Dabei bekommst du viel Freiheit.

Wenn du glaubst, dass Telefon funktioniert: Telefonieren.

Wenn persönliche Besuche funktionieren: Händler besuchen.

Wenn eine Messe spannend ist: hinfahren.

Wenn KI einen Prozess zehnmal schneller machen kann: automatisieren.

Wir wollen möglichst schnell herausfinden, welche B2B-Kanäle funktionieren, und diese anschließend massiv skalieren.

Zu deiner Bewerbung

Schick uns bitte keinen langen Standardtext.

Erzähl uns stattdessen kurz:

  1. Was hast du bisher im Vertrieb gemacht?
  2. Hast du schon einmal Produkte an Händler verkauft?
  3. Hast du Kontakte in den Kinder-, Spielwaren- oder Retail-Bereich?
  4. Wie würdest du vorgehen, wenn du in den nächsten 90 Tagen die ersten 100 neuen Ouchie-Händler gewinnen solltest?
  5. Welche KI- oder Sales-Tools nutzt du heute bereits?

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Willingness to work "3rd shift" when needed, to cover Asia as well as the west coast.

Partner with sales, product & engineering to ensure that customer’s needs are met

Prioritize and drive resolution for escalated customer issues

Understanding of SMB & NFS protocols tools

Understanding of Active Directory & Kerberos systems

Ability to parse and analyze system logs

Exceptional communication skills, with ability to prioritize competing escalations

Excellent troubleshooting skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams

Job Title: Director, Clinical FSP Delivery

Job Location: Durham

Job Location Type: Remote

Fortrea's is hiring a Director, Clinical FSP Delivery.

We are seeking a strategic client leader with a proven record of growing key accounts and driving exceptional client outcomes. The ideal candidate brings strong presentation and executive communication skills, extensive experience leading RFPs, bid defenses, and governance activities, and a results-driven approach to operational delivery. Success in this role requires the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, resolve challenges, influence decisions, and build trusted relationships across client and internal teams. The candidate will be a skilled negotiator, effective collaborator, and strategic partner who can align cross-functional teams, manage competing priorities, and consistently deliver business results.

Job Overview:

Establishes, leads, maintains and expands Clinical FSP customer relationships, whilst overseeing Clinical FSP delivery in alignment with agreements and customer strategy and vision. Responsible for new work supporting growth and engagement with clients to grow existing business and accounts.

Summary of Responsibilities:

  • These statements are intended to describe the general nature of the job and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills and duties.

  • Must have an excellent understanding of clinical operations within the FSP Delivery model. This role will be client facing, participating in RFP's and Bid Defenses, working internally with Project Management team, Regulatory Affairs, Start-up and others.

  • Responsible for one or more global/multiregional FSP partnerships or regional FSP partnerships of larger volume ( Greater than $15-20M annual revenue) or complexity across all clinical FSP functional areas serving as assigned customer(s’) primary and/or escalation point of contact.

  • Primary point of contact for assigned FSP customer(s) for internal stakeholders including Operational Leaders, Functional Heads, Finance, Business Development, Pricing and Strategy, Strategic Partnerships.

  • Responsible for overall delivery against MSA and managing overall quality aspects of critical deliverables (KPIs, milestones, quality audits, rebates), operationalize MSA and associated initiatives/projects, through partnership with the Clinical Network and other teams and internal stakeholders.

  • Establishes, owns, maintains and expands customer relationships, whilst overseeing Clinical FSP delivery in alignment with agreements and customer strategy and vision.

  • Assumes strategic oversight of their assigned customer(s) through defining strategy for strong high quality and timely delivery, as well as growth, effective risk management, proactively escalating potential risks to leadership and/or Executive Sponsor(s).

  • Collaborates with Strategic Partnership Director (where applicable) and Business Development on MSA negotiations, when required.

  • Oversees all clinical FSP service contract negotiations for new contracts and oversees/leads change orders for assigned customer, delegating where appropriate to the FSP Delivery team.

  • Upon award of new FSP services, establishes and defines delivery model, supports onboarding of all internal stakeholders to facilitate quality and timely implementation.

  • Oversees financial health of assigned partnerships by surveying budget burn and ensuring customer adherence to contractual payment terms to maintain within agreed margin, partnering with Accounts Receivable as needed.

  • Oversee and/or lead on monthly forecasting for assigned customer(s), ensuring timely communication to Finance Partner on any deviations from forecast.

  • Guides and leads the FSP Delivery team through defining a framework for governance and oversight for optimal service delivery to time and quality.

  • In partnership with Business Development, drives partnership expansion of FSP service lines by influencing internal and external stakeholder engagement, connecting subject matter experts and ensuring excellent FSP service delivery to contract terms and P and L.

  • Leads RFIs, RFPs, and BDM opportunities from a Clinical FSP Delivery perspective, working closely with Business Development, Proposals and other internal stakeholders.

  • Manages the work and execution of members of the FSP customer delivery team.

  • Supports and/or leads departments level initiatives including but not limited to clinical FSP strategy execution, new offering development, process improvement, etc.

  • Other duties as needed or assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • Bachelor’s degree – Life Sciences and/or Business Management.

  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • 10 years’ relevant industry experience (CRO/Pharmaceutical); or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

  • Minimum of five (5) years supervisory experience in a health care or clinical research setting.

  • Thorough knowledge of drug development process.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

  • Ability to lead independently global/multiregional FSP partnerships or large and/or complex regional FSP partnership and a team of Senior Managers, Clinical Service Delivery.

  • Proven ability to engage customers in discussions related to expanded partnerships, innovation, portfolio growth, pipeline, etc.

  • Demonstrated strong executive presence and ability to effectively challenge status quo and identify innovative ways to partner.

  • Ability to work independently to create and drive professional and productive relationships both internally and externally.

  • Agile in communication and able to negotiate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Excellent leadership skills with a proven ability to lead by example to inspire effective teamwork and to influence and constructively confront within a matrix organization.

  • Problem solver, out of the box thinker with the ability to translate ideas and data into tangible FSP operating models tailored to customer needs.

  • Broad understanding of commercialization, deal terms and conditions associated with various FSP models.

  • Demonstrated business acumen and strategic thinker, with an ability to think analytically to drive solutions.

  • Excellent planning and organizational skills including the skills necessary for implementing corporate change.

  • Excellent oral, written and presentation skills with a proven ability to professionally communicate with customers.

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

  • Standard office and/or home office based working conditions.

  • Extensive use of telephone and face-to-face communication requiring accurate perception of speech.

  • Frequent long, varied hours.

  • Travel Requirements: Domestic, Regional, Global 20-40% of time, with 80% that requires overnight stay (dependent on role location).

Office/Home-Based:

  • Home based role with travel up to 25%.

Physical Requirements:

  • Frequently stationary for 6-8 hours per day.

  • Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.

  • Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.

  • Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.

  • Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.

  • Regular and consistent attendance.

  • Varied hours may be required.

Benefits: All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data.

US Based Target Pay Range (based on title): $160-185K

About the Job:

The US Rare Disease, Strategic Account Manager will play a critical role in driving sales and optimizing care pathways for cross-lysosomal storage disease (xLSD) patients, ensuring formulary access, and building strategic relationships with key stakeholders to enhance patient outcomes and achieve organizational goals.

As a member of the Strategic Account Teams, the Account Manager will report into the Strategic Account Director, Commercial and will be responsible for delivering the highest quality of education and service regarding disease and treatment for the Sanofi Rare portfolio of products.

Across the Rare Disease Nation and our ‘one team, common goals, single mission’ approach, this role will be expected to hone a deep understanding of our key customers and their needs, strategically developing and co-creating tailored solutions to meet those needs.

Responsible for 5 therapeutic areas, 7 brands and building and gaining approval for account specific plans.

We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R&D to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs, and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing Progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Makes decisions and build plans with a combined business and scientific mindset.

  • Achieve and exceed patient sales targets. Educate targeted healthcare providers on the benefits of the full portfolio of Sanofi RD therapies within assigned accounts and regions.

  • Develop and communicate deep scientific understanding of xLSDs and Sanofi offerings.

  • Build awareness and early education of signs and symptoms of xLSD diseases.

  • Educate on the proper diagnosis pathway, diagnostic tests, and free testing programs. Communicate the clinical benefits, efficacy, and safety value proposition of Sanofi’s products.

  • Educate on product administration, expectations of treatment and the importance of adherence and compliance.

  • Support referral network: encourage referrals to “right” specialists to manage LSD treatment.

  • Understand and navigate key account ecosystem to cultivate and maintain long-term business relationships with customers and KOLs.

  • Develop and implement a galaxy-specific business plan and utilize all available resources to foster a successful sales environment and deliver on Rare Disease objectives.

  • Effectively convey complex clinical and reimbursement product information to key stakeholders in a highly competitive marketplace.

  • Collaborate effectively with Sanofi team members within region and cross-functionally.

  • Achieve and exceed assigned monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.

  • Travel as needed to assigned accounts and regions to meet with key stakeholders.

About You

Basic Qualifications

Minimum required skills & experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • 5+ years of sales experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.

  • Strong network development abilities, with a track record of establishing connections, referrals, and infrastructure for key accounts.

  • Strategic sales thinker with the ability to analyze complex market situations and develop innovative solutions to drive sales and optimize care.

  • Strong communication, interpersonal skills, and executive presence

  • Digital literacy and digital-first mindset

  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet with key stakeholders.

  • Track record of proven success

  • Candidates must live within 50 miles from 30322 zip code.

Preferred skills & experience:

  • Preferred experience in rare diseases or specialized therapeutic areas.

  • Strategic account management experience.

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

Sanofi Inc. and its U.S. affiliates are Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employers committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; creed; religion; national origin; age; ancestry; nationality; marital, domestic partnership or civil union status; sex, gender, gender identity or expression; affectional or sexual orientation; disability; veteran or military status or liability for military status; domestic violence victim status; atypical cellular or blood trait; genetic information (including the refusal to submit to genetic testing) or any other characteristic protected by law.

COMPANY

The Retention Analyst is the data engine behind RYZE's subscriber retention function. Reporting to the Retention Manager and working in close partnership with the VP, this role owns churn analysis, subscriber behavior modeling, retention metric reporting, and the analytical infrastructure that informs every retention program decision. The right candidate doesn't just produce reports — they surface the insight that changes what the Retention Manager builds next.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

What You’ll Do

  • Own churn data analysis — tracking cancellation rates, churn drivers, and at-risk subscriber patterns across cohorts

  • Build and maintain subscriber behavior models and segmentation frameworks to identify retention risk signals before they become cancellations

  • Tag, categorize, and trend cancellation reasons — surfacing actionable pattern insights for the Retention Manager's program design decisions

  • Develop and own the retention metrics dashboard — providing the Retention Manager and VP with weekly and monthly KPI visibility

  • Conduct LTV analysis and revenue impact modeling to quantify the cost of churn and the ROI of active retention programs

  • Build subscriber cohort reports across acquisition channel, product type, subscription length, and offer type

  • Support the Retention Manager with A/B test design and result analysis for save flows, win-back campaigns, and lifecycle interventions

  • Partner with Pillar 3 (CX Systems & Experience Tech) to ensure subscriber data flows accurately from Zendesk, Shopify, and Recharge into the analytics infrastructure

  • Partner with Analytics, Marketing, and Finance to ensure retention data is accurately reflected in broader business reporting

  • Maintain data documentation and ensure consistency and accuracy across all retention reporting

  • Additional duties as assigned by management.


WHAT WE OFFER

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • 2+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or retention analytics

  • Proficiency in data analysis tools — Excel/Google Sheets at advanced level; SQL preferred

  • Experience building dashboards and reports in BI tools (Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Google Data Studio, or similar)

  • Experience working with subscription, e-commerce, or DTC data — cohort analysis, retention curves, LTV modeling

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights from complex datasets

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills — able to present findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders

  • High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and consistency across all reporting

Preferred:

  • Experience with Shopify, Recharge, Klaviyo, or subscription analytics platforms

  • Background in health, wellness, food/beverage, or consumer subscription brands

  • Familiarity with Python or R for data manipulation and statistical analysis

  • Experience supporting A/B test analysis and evaluating statistical significance

  • Exposure to customer segmentation, churn prediction modeling, or machine learning applications in retention

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid time off and company holidays

  • Remote-first work environment with flexible scheduling

VIRTUAL59 - REMOTE/TELETRAVAIL - ON - BMO

Job Family Group:

Business Management

This role provides risk governance and advisory support for the Technology Group with a focus on risk management, regulatory compliance, control effectiveness, metrics, , and risk appetite alignment. The Business Risk Advisory Controls Team (BRAC) operates in a matrix environment, driving oversight, strengthening the control environment, and leveraging data-driven insights to enhance risk management practices and decision making.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert Regulatory Compliance support, guidance, and advice to T&O in support of the Enterprise Compliance Program (ECP) related to Technology.
  • Identify and communicate new and revised regulatory changes via the Enterprise Regulatory Development Framework (ERDF) and participate in execution of activities for implementation of Enterprise Compliance Program (ECP).
  • Contribute to the sound, efficient operation of T&O by improving the understanding and execution of Risk requirements in accordance with the Enterprise Operational Risk Management Framework (ORMF) related to technology.
  • Performance of risk assessments in accordance with ORMF and ECP requirements.
  • Maintain the T&O Process, Risk and Control (PRC) Framework, Tool, and Control Library to provide management a holistic view of the control environment
  • Manage oversight for all enterprise-level new/revised policies to determine T&O impact, including requests for review/feedback and communication of key policy changes
  • Leverage data to perform root cause and predictive analysis, and provide qualitative and quantitative risk and compliance management report.

Core Knowledge:

  • At least 10+ years of Technology or Financial industry work experience with a graduate or post-graduate degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, math or business management
  • At least 5 years of experience in risk and compliance domain with an ability to analyze and evaluate the observations based on compliance, operations, risk model and performance.
  • Ability to review all written materials for compliance with state, federal, and contractual regulations and draft all policy language and is desired
  • Strong data analytics and presentation skills, including advance level fluency in using Excel, Word and PowerPoint and other data analytics dashboard tools.
  • Ability to communicate complex or detailed technical topics to a non-technical business audience, clearly conveying risk assessments, actions needed, and cost implications.
  • CRISC, CGEIT, CISA, CISM, PMP and/or Cloud compliance certification an asset
  • Good data analytics and reporting skills including advance excel and power point skills and skills to use desktop analytics tools.
  • Knowledge of software development practice, concepts/methodologies and technology obtained through formal training and/or work experience
  • Knowledge of data governance frameworks and how these are implemented in complex and large organizations.
  • Well versed in the technology issues affecting financial service organizations and cloud based application service providers
  • Understands the basic tenants of enterprise risk management process (Identify, assess, prioritize, treat and monitor).

Contributes to the business’ accountability for the delivery of regulatory programs across applicable Tier 1 Risk Types. Contributes to the design of governance and control requirements for products, processes, and channels. Supports the design, development, automation, and coordination of evidence based controls across Credit & Counterparty, Non Financial, Liquidity & Funding, Market, Strategic, Reputation, and Environmental & Social Risks. Supports effective and efficient compliance with regulatory obligations in alignment with the Bank’s Risk Management Framework and approved Risk Appetite.

  • Makes recommendations to senior leaders on strategy and new initiatives, based on an in-depth understanding of the business/group.

  • Acts as a subject matter expert on relevant regulations and policies.

  • Acts as a strategic partner in which the program elements becomes an integrated component of the overall business/group strategies and helps drive business impact.

  • Prepares and briefs senior leaders on regulatory matters across multiple businesses/groups.

  • Supports multiple, similar business units with moderate complexity & business transaction risk.

  • Represents the business/group on Governance/Risk Working Groups/Forums and provides regular updates.

  • Monitors and advises on management of risk requirements within the defined risk appetite.

  • Manages/supports large/complex risk programs/frameworks /projects/initiatives to ensure risks are appropriately mitigated and regulations adhered to.

  • Monitors industry and legislative developments and continuously updates programs to ensure they are competitive and effective.

  • Supports the position on regulatory compliance issues by interpreting requirements (existing, new and emerging) and identifying, analysing and addressing resultant gaps and issues, including those raised through the review of change initiatives. Understands the identified risk exposures and supports the development of action plans required to mitigate identified risks.

  • Acts as a subject matter expert in the evaluation, development and implementation of an internal control system.

  • May network with industry contacts to gain competitive insights and best practices.

  • Recommends business priorities, advises on resource requirements and develops roadmap for strategic execution.

  • Manages resources and leads the execution of strategic initiatives to deliver on business and financial goals.

  • Conducts independent analysis and assessment to resolve strategic issues.

  • Builds effective relationships with internal/external stakeholders.

  • Ensures alignment between stakeholders.

  • Acts as the prime subject matter expert for internal/external stakeholders.

  • Breaks down strategic problems, and analyses data and information to provide insights and recommendations.

  • Monitors and tracks performance, and addresses any issues.

  • Leads change management programs of varying scope and type, including readiness assessments, planning, stakeholder management, execution, evaluation and sustainment of initiatives.

  • Leads the execution of operational programs; assesses and adapts as needed to ensure quality of execution.

  • Monitoring to ensure that 1st line jobs are following defined processes and procedures.

  • Develops, documents and maintains business/group procedures updating and obtaining approvals as regulations or the operating environment changes and communicates changes to the business/group & relevant stakeholder groups.

  • Designs measurable sustainment strategies including assessing and recommending mitigations for industry/ segment-specific risks and prioritizing opportunities presented by internal and external stakeholders.

  • Tracks exception/exemption requests and corresponding approvals.

  • Facilitates training to ensure business unit employees fully understand requirements.

  • Provides quality control for investigations, self-reports, examinations and independent reviews conducted by internal and external stakeholders, including regulators, providing verbal and written responses to requests for positions, action plans, information and/or documentation

  • May act as the designated Primary Business Unit Compliance Officer (BUCO) and/or Anti-Money Laundering Reporting Officer for the operating group and is accountable to meet all program requirements (e.g., Operating Group Compliance Program, AML Program Framework).

  • Builds awareness, knowledge, and skills and, as necessary, provides communication, practical tools and ongoing support including making presentations, to promote a culture of risk identification and management.

  • Supports the design, development, coordination of implementation, automation and continuous improvement of 1LOD LOB risk management programs, including supporting the establishment and maintenance of LOB specific policies standards, business processes and controls across all applicable financial and non-financial risks.

  • Works with assigned business/group leaders to interpret, apply and operationalize relevant regulatory frameworks across the LOB/jurisdiction and designs, develops, coordinates and continually improves the LOBs risk management programs and supporting activities to ensure the business operates within the approved risk appetite and optimizes risk return while meeting BMO’s regulatory compliance obligations and consistent with the Bank’s Risk Management Framework

  • Conducts or supports self-assessments to demonstrate control effectiveness and adherence, coordinating 1LOD risk remediation efforts, responding to regulatory requirements, implementing policies, and managing risk measurement and reporting.

  • Develops and maintains an understanding of the business/group strategies and objectives, products and services, internal and external stakeholders and business processes as well as the underlying infrastructure to identify and manage implications and risk exposures for the business/group.

  • Identifies, investigates, analyzes, documents & mitigates program risks, taking into account jurisdictional issues, and raises any issues or concerns to senior leaders and other stakeholders.

  • Analyzes the impact and effectiveness of the program through periodic reviews.

  • Recommends adjustments to the overall program, policy or processes within the business/group in accordance with the Risk Appetite Statement, Governance and Corporate Policy.

  • Supports the business/group through internal/external audits or regulatory examinations and assists in development of action plans to resolve any identified issues.

  • Provides support to the development and delivery of training and awareness programs within the business/group to increase awareness of and compliance to risk management requirements.

  • Takes measured risks while protecting the bank by applying our Risk Management Framework in the execution of your role, in line with our Risk Culture and within our approved Risk Appetite, making sound and risk informed decisions that align to business strategy, protect assets, and adhere to applicable policy documents (Frameworks, Policies, Standards, Procedures and Supporting documents), laws and regulations.

  • Operates at a group/enterprise-wide level and serves as a specialist resource to senior leaders and stakeholders.

  • Applies expertise and thinks creatively to address unique or ambiguous situations and to find solutions to problems that can be complex and non-routine.

Qualifications:

  • Program Management skills - Expert.

  • Seasoned professional with a combination of education, experience and industry knowledge.

  • Verbal & written communication skills - In-depth / Expert.

  • Analytical and problem solving skills - In-depth / Expert.

  • Influence skills - In-depth / Expert.

  • Collaboration & team skills; with a focus on cross-group collaboration - In-depth / Expert.

  • Able to manage ambiguity.

  • Data driven decision making - In-depth / Expert.

$86,000.00 - $160,000.00

Pay Type:

Salaried

POSITION: CERTIFICATION SPECIALIST

LOCATION: Remote

We are seeking candidates who possess a willingness to grow and thrive in an ever-changing and expanding organization.

  • Work from Home Position, Monday through Friday 8 AM to 5 PM. (These are our hours of operation and are non-negotiable.)
  • Effective communication skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

  • This role requires you to have multiple responsibilities that will need to be done daily.

raw.description:
Have you ever enjoyed Arnold®, Brownberry® or Oroweat® bread? A Thomas’® English muffin or bagel? Or perhaps snacked on a Sara Lee®, Entenmann’s® or Marinela® cake or donut? If the answer is yes, then you know Bimbo Bakeries USA!
More than 20,000 associates in bakeries, sales centers, offices and on sales routes work to ensure our consumers have the freshest products at every meal. In addition to competitive pay and benefits, we provide a safe and inclusive work environment that appreciates diversity, promotes development and allows our associates to be their authentic selves.
Come join the largest baking company in the world and our family of 20,000 associates nationwide!

Top Reasons to Work at Bimbo Bakeries USA:

Salary Range: $105,100 - $147,100

Annual Bonus Eligibility

Comprehensive Benefits Package

Paid Time Off

401k & Company Match

*** This role is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere within the United States preferably in the Central Region ***

Position Summary:

This role leads and influences the execution of continuous improvement and operations excellence strategies across regional bakeries in fast-paced manufacturing environments. The position provides senior-level direction, change leadership, and capability building with Regional Bakery Directors, Bakery Leaders, and front-line teams to sustain the Operations Excellence Playbook, reinforce E5 behaviors, and deliver measurable gains in safety, quality, productivity, waste reduction, and profitability. The role requires domestic travel up to 50% and may support various unanticipated work locations throughout the U.S.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Direct coordination and leadership with Regional Bakery Directors and Bakery Leaders to build organizational skills and capabilities that sustain the Operations Excellence Playbook and E5 behaviors.
  • Create and sustain a continuous improvement environment by improving products, service, and processes with the objective of reducing waste while driving efficiency and profitability.
  • Ensure process compliance and appropriate continuous improvement tools are in place and fully utilized to support associate empowerment and data-driven decision making.
  • Perform advanced data analysis to identify opportunities for cost savings, waste reduction, productivity improvement, and operational effectiveness.
  • Provide strategic and hands-on support to operations management in the identification, development, communication, and execution of manufacturing transformation and bakery productivity plans.
  • Facilitate Root Cause Problem Solving, Line Balance workshops, and Agile kaizen events that generate corrective actions for complex bakery productivity and operational performance issues.
  • Act as a change agent supporting Operations Excellence Front End Loading activities in Great Britain Model launches and Sprint Bakery productivity work.
  • Work closely with production, maintenance, sanitation, quality, distribution, and reliability teams to reduce waste, increase machine productivity, improve product quality, and ensure maintenance is integrated into problem solving and PFA events.
  • Ensure facility improvement initiatives support corporate strategy, General Plant Safety, Food Safety, Food Defense Initiatives, and Good Manufacturing Practices.
  • Drive change through facilities and cross-functional teams to deliver plant cost savings targets and manufacturing transformation objectives.
  • Provide change management support for Digital Workplace and the adoption of new processes and digital tools, including Digital Codebooks, ODI, Digital Dough Sheet, and Power BI reports.
  • Partner with manufacturing transformation, plant operations, reliability, maintenance transformation, and plant engineering teams during preparation, analysis, planning, and implementation while incorporating safety and quality standards.
  • Liaise with front-line supervision on the design and implementation of Standard Work and support standardization and sustainability of manufacturing transformation elements.
  • Deliver training and coaching to operations managers, change architects, associates, and other stakeholders on manufacturing transformation fundamentals and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Prepare and deliver formal presentations to regional senior management on project status, deliverables, line balance findings, and regional productivity initiative milestones.
  • Conduct process studies to identify opportunities for increased line effectiveness and prepare statistical analysis of process capability to implement improved controls.
  • Provide leadership support in the design and execution of systems and floor projects that advance operational capability and transformation outcomes.
  • Travel up to 80% nationwide.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Situational Adaptability- adapts approach and attitude in real time, according to the changing demands of different situations.
  • Drives Engagement- creates a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives.
  • Ensures Accountability - holds self and others accountable to meet commitments.
  • Manages Complexity – makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Education and Work History:

  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering.
  • 6+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment involving operations, quality, or food safety; leadership of cross-functional teams and facilitation of Root Cause Problem Solving, Line Balance workshops, and training.
  • Continuous improvement related to safety, good manufacturing practice, waste reduction, labor, line running efficiencies, sanitation, and productivity improvement.
  • Implementation of continuous improvement methodologies such as SMED, 5S, Gemba Walks, 5 Whys, DMAIC, and related manufacturing transformation tools.
  • Experience supporting change management, digital process adoption, and regional operations excellence initiatives is required.
The physical and mental demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be requested to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Job Description

Join Us as a Clinical Research Associate (Level II) – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Clinical Research Associate (Level II), you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.

This posting is available to candidates located in the Western United States (WA, OR, CA, MT, ID, WY, UT, CO, AZ, NV, NM).

Up to 75% domestic travel is expected for successful performance in this role.

What You’ll Do:
• Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies rootcause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify siteprocesses failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site intocompliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV andCRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities.Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable
• Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS). Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.
• Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
• Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
• Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools, and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).
• Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
• Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
• Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
• Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Education and Experience Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related field or a Registered Nursing certification or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
• Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2+ years as a clinical research monitor).
• Valid driver's license where applicable
• In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Effective clinical monitoring skills

• Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
• Excellent understanding and demonstrated application of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
• Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to critical mindset, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving
• Ability to manages Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
• Effective oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
• Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detailand the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
• Effective interpersonal skills
• Strong attention to detail
• Effective organizational and time management skills
• Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
• Ability to work in a team or independently as required
• Good computer skills: proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software
• Good English language and grammar skills
• Good presentation skills

Working Conditions and Environment:
• Working Conditions and Environment:
• Work is performed in an office/ laboratory/clinical/and/or home office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
• Frequent drives to site locations. Frequent travel, generally 60-80% but more for some individuals.
• May also include extended overnight stays.
• Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
• Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.
• Exposure to fluctuating and/or extreme temperatures on rare occasions.
• Must be able to comply with specific sponsor/client/site requirements, even if not required by Thermo Fisher Scientific (e.g., disclosure of vaccination status, or other personal information). On some occasions, this information may be required to be provided directly to sponsor/client/site.

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range estimated for this position based in California is $88,600.00–$132,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

  • A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs

  • Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement

  • At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy

  • Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan

  • Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)

Additional requirements

  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $40 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. You will work closely with internal stakeholders to align link acquisition efforts with broader SEO and marketing objectives while continuously identifying opportunities to improve campaign performance and return on investment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research, evaluate, and secure high-quality backlink opportunities
  • Assess domain quality, topical relevance, authority metrics, and traffic potential
  • Conduct competitor and market analysis to identify acquisition opportunities
  • Develop and refine link acquisition strategies based on client objectives
  • Monitor backlink performance and contribute recommendations for optimization
  • Ensure timely activation, indexation, and quality control of acquired links
  • Maintain accurate documentation and campaign reporting
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align link-building activities with overall SEO strategy
  • Build and maintain relationships with publishers and external partners where required
  • Stay up to date with SEO trends, search engine developments, and industry best practices
  • Report & collaborate directly with the CEO

Requirements

What You'll Bring

Previous experience working with link building and/or link acquisition is a must.

  • Great understanding of backlink quality signals and SEO performance metrics
  • Experience using SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Majestic, or similar platforms
  • Ability to evaluate domains based on metrics such as DR, DA, traffic, relevance, and link profile quality
  • Strong outreach skills, in particular via e-mail & text outreach channels
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Professional communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment
  • Experience from an SEO agency, affiliate marketing, iGaming, SaaS, or digital marketing environment, as well as experience with business negotiation, is considered highly advantageous

Benefits

Benefits

  • Flexibility in a fully remote work setup
  • Very competitive salary; 30-45k EUR base salary, depending on experience
  • Commission based on performance & targets
  • Work in a startup culture with ability to shape & improve procedures
  • Build and expand your own portfolio of publication sites & link building partners with free hands

CircusTrix dba

Sky Zone

Senior Manager, Web Strategy & Optimization

Full-Time

Hybrid in Dallas, TX, or Remote in O&O States

Department: Commercial

Reports to: Director, Digital Experiences

Travel: N/A

FLSA: Exempt

ABOUT US:

CircusTrix is the leading indoor active entertainment company in the U.S., operating and franchising over 270 parks with more than 500,000 members and 60+ attractions. We create fun, high-energy experiences for all ages while hosting thousands of memorable birthdays, team events, and school parties each year. Recognized by Franchise Times and Entrepreneur, our success is driven by a culture of curiosity, creativity, and growth. At Sky Zone, we empower builders, problem-solvers, and lifelong learners to explore bold ideas, challenge assumptions, and make a meaningful impact—creating a place where imagination thrives and people are inspired to grow.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Web Strategy & Optimization

  • Own and execute the day-to-day web strategy across Sky Zone’s digital experience.
  • Prioritize enhancements based on customer needs, business objectives, revenue opportunities, and performance data.
  • Lead website optimization initiatives that improve conversion, engagement, accessibility, and overall user experience.
  • Support key business initiatives, promotions, and campaigns by ensuring the website delivers a cohesive, high-performing brand experience.
  • Establish governance and standards for website functionality, performance, SEO, and ADA compliance.
  • Develop business cases and recommendations for web enhancements and investments.

Web Roadmap & Requirements

  • Partner with the Director, Digital Experiences to help develop and execute the digital roadmap for the future evolution of Sky Zone’s website, including capital projects (e.g., 2027 initiatives).
  • Define requirements and partner cross-functionally to move the platform from its current state to the long-term vision.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, digital best practices, and industry trends to inform roadmap priorities.
  • Recommend new capabilities, tools, and platform enhancements that improve the guest experience and drive business growth.

Conversion & Experimentation

  • Own website conversion and revenue performance.
  • Identify opportunities to increase ticket and party bookings, membership purchases, and ancillary revenue through website enhancements.
  • Drive prioritization of initiatives based on revenue impact.
  • Lead CRO strategy and testing based on data and potential impact.

Customer Experience & Personalization

  • Lead website CX and personalization strategy.
  • Partner closely with CRM to leverage Web SDK capabilities, Content Cards, and audience-based experiences.
  • Develop customer segmentation strategies that improve engagement and conversion.
  • Optimize customer journeys through behavioral insights and testing.
  • Champion best-in-class UX across key conversion paths.

Analytics & Executive Reporting

  • Serve as the primary owner of website performance reporting.
  • Develop dashboards and KPI goals tied to business outcomes.
  • Analyze customer behavior, funnel performance, and conversion trends to identify actionable business opportunities.
  • Develop and deliver strategic recommendations to leadership

Leadership & Partnership

  • Provide subject matter expertise and help drive execution across Sky Zone’s web experience and digital optimization initiatives.
  • Lead, coach, and develop team members while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the business owner for website platforms, tools, and key technology partners.
  • Influence vendor roadmaps and partner closely with internal teams to prioritize initiatives that drive business value.
  • Evaluate innovative technologies, platforms, and capabilities that improve customer experience, accessibility, conversion, and revenue.
  • Partner with IT on vendor evaluations, contract negotiations, and renewals.

Web Ops & Governance

  • Own the operational health and governance of the Sky Zone website, ensuring a reliable, secure, and high-performing digital experience.
  • Lead ongoing SEO, ADA compliance, legal review coordination, and website governance initiatives.
  • Manage the website release process, QA, documentation, and cross-functional communication for new launches and enhancements.
  • Develop and maintain operational processes, standards, and documentation that support a scalable web program.
  • Stay current on emerging technologies, including AI and LLM capabilities, and identify opportunities to improve digital experience and internal workflows.
  • Remain hands-on with web platforms, analytics, and optimization tools to support execution, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Web Strategy, Marketing, Business, Digital Media, Ecommerce, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience leading website strategy, ecommerce, digital experience, and/or conversion optimization initiatives. Prior experience with an entertainment, franchise, and/or retail business a plus.
  • Proven experience driving measurable improvements in website performance, online revenue, and conversion rates through data-driven optimization.
  • Strong understanding of customer journey mapping, user experience (UX), conversion rate optimization (CRO), and website personalization strategies.
  • Experience translating business objectives into digital strategies, prioritizing initiatives, and delivering measurable business results.
  • Proficiency with web analytics and optimization tools including GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Google Tag Manager, and content management systems (WordPress preferred).
  • Experience partnering with CRM or marketing automation teams to deliver personalized web experiences (Braze experience preferred).
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate customer behavior and performance data into proactive and actionable business recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders and presenting recommendations to leadership.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, vendors, and cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and passion for creating exceptional digital experiences that drive customer satisfaction and business growth.
  • This role is equal parts strategy and hands-on execution — comfortable building requirements, running QA, testing, and troubleshooting just as much as shaping strategic recommendations and presenting to leadership.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This position requires the ability to remain stationery, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Compensation range is $112,000-$125,000 + bonus opportunity,based on qualifications, experience, and performance. Full-time employees at CircusTrix enjoy a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage along with a 401k plan with company matching. Eligibility for 401k is based on age and tenure requirements.

Application deadline: September 6, 2026

While we anticipate the application window will close on this date, Sky Zone reviews applications on a rolling basis and will continue to consider candidates until the position is filled. As a result, the posting may remain up beyond the stated deadline, but will not be removed before this date.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Position Overview

We are seeking a high-energy, results-driven ISV OEM Channel Manager to spearhead the growth of our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) and Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) partner ecosystem. Please note this is a Contract position with a potential Contract-to-Hire opportunity.

In this role, you will identify, recruit, and manage strategic software vendors who want to embed or white-label Alteryx’s engine, workflow automation, and analytics/AI capabilities directly into their own applications.

This is initially a contract position with strong potential to convert to full-time hire (CTH) based on performance, account traction, and organizational growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner Acquisition & Deal Structuring: Identify, prospect, and recruit target ISVs and technology partners to embed/integrate Alteryx technology into their SaaS or on-premises solutions.

  • Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Collaborate with ISV/OEM partners to design joint solution architectures, commercial models (e.g., royalty, revenue share, embedded license models), and joint GTM execution plans.

  • Cross-Functional Execution: Work closely with Alteryx Product Management, Legal, Technical Sales, and Engineering teams to define technical integration paths and negotiate complex commercial/OEM agreements.

  • Pipeline & Revenue Generation: Maintain direct responsibility for driving partner-influenced and embedded OEM revenue against quarterly targets.

  • Enablement & Technical Adoption: Drive technical and sales enablement initiatives within partner organizations, ensuring partner engineering and product teams effectively leverage Alteryx as their underlying analytics and logic engine.

  • Partner Governance: Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs), manage joint account planning, and maintain healthy executive alignment between Alteryx and partner organizations.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 6+ years in Channel Management, ISV Partnerships, Business Development, or OEM Sales within the Enterprise Software/SaaS space.

  • Data Domain Knowledge: Proven understanding of Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery), or Enterprise AI applications.

  • Deal Structuring Mastery: Track record of structuring and closing complex OEM, embedded software, or white-label licensing contracts.

  • Technical Aptitude: Ability to bridge the gap between technical teams (Product/Engineering) and business executives to articulate the value of embedded analytics and governed workflow automation.

  • Execution Focus: A strong self-starter comfortable operating in autonomous, high-velocity environments with short execution cycles.

  • CRM Proficiency: Experience managing pipeline, accounts, and GTM milestones in Salesforce.com.

Contract & Conversion Details

  • Contract Duration: 6–12 months initial period.

  • Conversion Potential: Opportunity to convert to a permanent FTE position based on mutual fit, partner pipeline momentum, and organizational headcount needs.

raw.description:
About the Role

The Appointment Scheduling platform at Engageware is the front door to some of the most important moments in a customer's day — booking time with their banker, checking in at the branch, waiting in queue, or meeting virtually with a specialist. Behind those experiences sits a suite of purpose-built applications: a multi-tenant admin console, customer-facing scheduling interfaces, in-branch self-check-in kiosks, queue management and concierge tools for branch staff, and virtual channel integrations — all running at enterprise scale for leading banks, credit unions, and healthcare organizations.

We're looking for a Principal UI Developer who can own this surface end-to-end. That means leading the migration of our Angular application estate to React, setting the front-end architecture and design system, owning features all the way through the API layer when needed, and bringing strong design sensibility to interfaces that have had limited dedicated design attention. This is a high-leverage role, and we expect AI tooling to be a meaningful part of how you operate — scaffolding components, generating tests, assisting with Angular-to-React migration, exploring design directions quickly — so the scope is real but so is the support.

What You'll Do

React Migration & Front-End Architecture

  • Own the migration strategy for the Appointment Scheduling front-end estate — defining how and in what sequence we move existing Angular applications (admin console, scheduling flows, kiosk, queue management, concierge) to a modern React foundation.
  • Establish the shared component library, design tokens, state management patterns (React Query, Zustand, or Redux Toolkit), and routing architecture that all new and migrated applications are built on.
  • Make pragmatic migration decisions — incremental strangler-fig patterns vs. targeted rebuilds — balancing speed, risk, and continuity for live enterprise customers.
  • Define the module boundaries and shared abstractions that allow Angular and React to coexist safely during the transition.

Design System & Interface Quality

  • Own the visual and interaction language for the Appointment Scheduling platform: component library, spacing system, color tokens, typography, and interaction patterns — maintained in Storybook and connected to Figma where design work happens.
  • Bring design sensibility to every interface you ship. In the absence of dedicated design resources, you are the person who catches the awkward empty state, the unclear confirmation flow, the button that doesn't belong. You use AI design tools (Figma AI, v0, Claude) to explore and prototype directions quickly rather than waiting for a design brief.
  • Ensure all applications meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards — a non-negotiable for banking and healthcare customers with regulatory obligations.
  • Optimize for the full deployment surface: responsive web, touch-screen kiosks (constrained sizes, high-contrast, minimal input complexity), and staff-facing branch tablets in fast-paced environments.

API Layer & End-to-End Feature Ownership

  • Own features end-to-end when the critical path runs through the front end: design and build the BFF (Backend for Frontend) endpoints, lightweight Spring Boot routes, and data-shaping layers the UI requires — without waiting on someone else to unblock you.
  • Design clean REST API contracts between front-end applications and the scheduling platform services, with clear error-handling conventions and versioning.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers on deeper service-layer work, contributing meaningfully to API design reviews and surfacing front-end integration requirements early.
  • Handle the full stack of front-end reliability concerns: caching strategies, optimistic UI, graceful degradation, and real-time event handling (WebSockets, SSE) where the scheduling experience demands it.

Test-Driven Development & Quality

  • Champion test-driven development across all front-end work: unit tests, component tests, and end-to-end tests written alongside code, not after.
  • Establish and enforce testing standards using Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright or Cypress — so the team can migrate, refactor, and ship with confidence.
  • Use AI-assisted test generation as an accelerant, not a shortcut: AI scaffolds the coverage, you ensure it's meaningful and deterministic.
  • Lead front-end code reviews focused on testability, maintainability, and architectural consistency.

AI-Augmented Development

  • Operate with AI as a core part of your workflow: use coding agents (built on Claude) for component scaffolding, Angular-to-React migration assistance, test generation, accessibility audits, and design exploration via v0 or Figma AI.
  • Help the team adopt AI-augmented development confidently — setting the guardrails (review standards, coverage requirements) that keep quality high when AI is doing real work.
  • Stay current on agentic development patterns (including MCP-based tooling) as the ecosystem evolves rapidly.

Technical Leadership

  • Set the front-end technical direction for the Appointment Scheduling team, documenting architectural decisions so the team builds consistently.
  • Mentor front-end engineers on React, TypeScript, testing, accessibility, and API integration.
  • Partner directly with the Principal PM and Team Lead on new features — shaping what is buildable, raising UX and implementation concerns early, and influencing decisions before specs are locked.

What We're Looking For

Must-have qualifications:

  • 8+ years in front-end or full-stack web development, with 3+ years at a senior or principal IC level owning front-end architecture for a production application suite.
  • Expert-level React and TypeScript — hooks, concurrent features, performance optimization, and common state management patterns.
  • Real experience migrating Angular applications to React in production, with the judgment to choose incremental migration over rewrites where appropriate.
  • Strong Angular fluency (multiple versions) — you need to read, reason about, and migrate existing codebases confidently.
  • Ability and willingness to own the API layer for front-end features: BFF patterns, REST endpoint design, and working in Spring Boot (Java) for UI-adjacent services.
  • Genuine design sensibility — you can look at an interface and know what's wrong with it, and you're comfortable making design decisions in the absence of a dedicated designer.
  • Rigorous test-driven development discipline — tests come with the code, not after.
  • Proficiency with React Testing Library, Jest or Vitest, and Playwright or Cypress.
  • Solid WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility knowledge — designed and built in from the start.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding and design tools as a genuine productivity multiplier, not a curiosity.
  • Based in the United States, with willingness to travel occasionally for team and customer meetings.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building scheduling, calendar, or real-time availability interfaces.
  • Background in financial services, banking, credit unions, healthcare, or retail technology.
  • Figma proficiency — able to create and maintain a component library and design tokens, not just consume them.
  • Experience with Storybook for component documentation and testing.
  • Micro Frontend architecture or module federation experience for managing multi-app front-end ecosystems.
  • Depth in kiosk or large-format touch UX — the constraints are different from a browser tab and most candidates haven't been there.

Our Stack

Knowing our stack is not a requirement, but this is what you'll be working with:

  • Frontend (current): Angular (multiple versions) — the estate you'll be migrating from
  • Frontend (target): React with TypeScript — the standard for all new and migrated applications
  • Design: Figma, Storybook; AI design tooling (v0, Figma AI)
  • API layer: Spring Boot (Java 17) and Scala/Akka services over REST
  • Testing: React Testing Library, Jest / Vitest, Playwright / Cypress
  • Data: SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS
  • AI: Claude models (Anthropic), with MCP-based agent tooling
